summary: Red Bull emerges as the championship favorite after dominating Friday practice, with Russell and Leclerc acknowledging Max Verstappen's team as the pace-setter heading into race day. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc hunts for a breakthrough performance against the Milton Keynes outfit, setting up a critical midfield battle that could reshape points distribution. A victory this weekend solidifies Red Bull's grip on the title race, while any slip delivers a crucial opening for challengers fighting to keep the championship alive.
